news.title: New major risk - Market cap size
news.body: The company's market capitalization is less than US$10m. Market cap: ₹928.1m (US$9.95m) This is considered a major risk. Companies with a small market capitalization are most likely businesses that have not yet released a product to market or are simply a very small company without a wide reach. Either way, risk is elevated with these companies because there is a chance the product may not come to fruition or the company's addressable market or demand may not be as large as expected. In addition, if the company's size is the main factor, it is less likely to have many investors and analysts following it and scrutinizing its performance and outlook. news.title: Fortis Malar Hospitals Limited Announces Board Changes, Effective from January 18, 2026
news.body: Fortis Malar Hospitals Limited announced that based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee of the Company, the Board of Directors of the Company through circular resolution, had approved the appointment of Mr. Bidesh Chandra Paul (DIN: 08596135) as an Additional Director (Non-Independent) of the Company effective from January 18, 2026 (close of business hours). Mr. Chandrasekar Ramaswamy (DIN: 09414564) had resigned from the directorship of the Company, was serving as Whole Time Director and KMP as well (Executive & Non-Independent Director) and accordingly, ceased to be Director of the Company effective from January 18, 2026 (close of business hours). Mr. Bidesh Chandra Paul is a healthcare and operations leader with over 15 years of experience in manufacturing
